visu.accueil.aide: “{nom}” opens first in Visualisation for the selected roles, except for people who chose their own default view. A role has only one home view, so this view replaces its current one.

visu.avert.hors_perimetre.one: {n} item outside your scope is ignored.
visu.avert.hors_perimetre.other: {n} items outside your scope are ignored.

visu.avert.kpi_rediges.one: {n} KPI with a written answer is not shown (no chart).
visu.avert.kpi_rediges.other: {n} KPIs with a written answer are not shown (no chart).

visu.avert.trop_de_kpis: The list shows only the first {max} KPIs. Choose themes to shorten it.
visu.couleurs.aide: The series use these colours, in this order. From the 9th series: the “Other” colour.
visu.couleurs.alerte: Some colours are too light (contrast below 3:1). On the charts, the values of their series are always written.
visu.couleurs.erreur: A chart colour is not valid. Enter each colour in the format #RRGGBB.
visu.couleurs.par_defaut: Default palette, checked for colour blindness.
visu.definition.decompte: number of answers for each value
visu.definition.vide: No written definition for this KPI.
visu.erreur.identifiant: Visual {n}: the identifier is not valid or is used twice.
visu.erreur.kpi_invisible: Visual {n}: “{code}” is not a KPI you can see.
visu.erreur.option: Visual {n}: the setting “{option}” is not valid.
visu.erreur.reseau: The server did not respond. Try again.
visu.erreur.source: Visual {n}: the list or theme no longer exists.
visu.etat.aucune_periode: No period has a campaign yet.
visu.etat.brouillons: Drafts included: a value marked ◐ is provisional (it depends on a value not yet validated).
visu.export.attente_texte: a value exists but is not validated yet: it is not shown.
visu.export.nombres_texte: Exact numbers, with the decimals of the unit. Percentages from 0 to 100. The unit and the direction of a change (▲ ▼ =) are in the cell format: the cell stays a number.
visu.export.perimetre_texte: Data from your scope: only the organisations you can see are exported.
visu.export.provisoire_texte: value that depends on at least one value not yet validated (drafts included).
visu.export.sans_donnees: No data to export for this visual.
visu.export.validee_texte: validated value (or calculated from validated values only).
visu.filtres.org_ignoree: The saved organisation is outside your scope: the view shows {org}.
visu.filtres.periode_ignoree: The saved period no longer exists: the view shows {periode}.
visu.kpi.rediges_exclus: Written KPIs are not listed: they have no chart.
visu.parametres.accueil_aide: The shared view that opens when a person arrives on Visualisation. A person who chose their own default view keeps it.
visu.parametres.aucune_partagee: No shared view yet. To share a view, open it and choose “View …” › “Share with everyone”.
visu.parametres.vue_inconnue: One of the chosen views is no longer shared. Reload the page.
visu.parametres.vues_max_aide: 10 by default. Shared views do not count.
visu.raison.pas_campagne: No campaign found (in “I am answering” or in the filters).
visu.raison.pas_dessous: This KPI is entered at the {niveau} level. There is nothing below to compare.
visu.raison.pas_dessous_org: No organisation under {org} in your scope.
visu.raison.reponses_barres: A yes / no or list answer is shown as stacked bars.
visu.raison.reponses_courbe: A yes / no or list answer is shown as a table, period by period.
visu.raison.reponses_n1: A yes / no or list answer has no variance vs N-1.
visu.raison.sans_kpi: This type does not depend on a KPI.
visu.raison.un_kpi: This type shows a single KPI.
visu.raison.une_periode: At least 2 periods of the same type are needed.
visu.raison.unites_differentes: The KPIs do not share the same unit.
visu.reglages.aucun: Select a visual to change its settings.
visu.reglages.aucun_kpi: No KPI yet. Add KPIs from the KPI list.
visu.reglages.selectionne: Visual “{titre}” selected: its settings are open.
visu.reglages.titre_aide: If empty, the title is the KPI name.
visu.remplissage.aucune_campagne: No known campaign for this framework and period.
visu.visuel.deplacer_consigne: Left or up arrow: move earlier. Right or down arrow: move later. Home or End: move to the start or the end.
visu.visuel.erreur: This visual could not be calculated.
visu.visuel.forme_inconnue: This chart type no longer exists: choose another one.
visu.visuel.kpi_indisponible: This KPI is no longer available (deleted, deactivated, or outside your scope).
visu.visuel.kpi_redige: Written answer: no figure or chart. You can read the answers in Data entry and in the exports.
visu.visuel.par_sommet: One line per organisation in your scope (no total outside your scope).
visu.visuel.perimetres_differents: The organisations counted are not the same in {periode} and {comparaison} (opened, closed or moved): the change also comes from that.
visu.visuel.points_aria: Chart: use the arrow keys to move through the values, and Escape to hide the details.
visu.visuel.rien: Nothing to show for these filters.
visu.visuel.source_disparue: The list or theme no longer exists.
visu.visuel.trop_de_kpis: At most {max} KPIs in this visual.
visu.visuel.unites_differentes: The units are different, so the KPI is added in a new visual.
visu.vue.accueil_aucun: “{nom}” is the home view of no role.
visu.vue.conflit: This view was changed in the meantime. Reload the page to see the new version. Until then, your changes stay on this page.
visu.vue.depart_aide: View suggested by the tool, not saved. To keep it, click “Save as view”.
visu.vue.deposer: Drop a KPI here to create a visual

visu.vue.dupliquee_sans.one: {n} visual outside your scope was not copied.
visu.vue.dupliquee_sans.other: {n} visuals outside your scope were not copied.

visu.vue.filtres_gardes: Filters kept. Click “Save view” to save them with the view.
visu.vue.json_invalide: The view definition cannot be read.

visu.vue.limite_perso.one: You have reached the maximum of {n} personal view. Delete it or ask an administrator.
visu.vue.limite_perso.other: You have reached the maximum of {n} personal views. Delete one or ask an administrator.

visu.vue.masques.one: {n} visual in this view does not concern you.
visu.vue.masques.other: {n} visuals in this view do not concern you.

visu.vue.masques_gardes.one: {n} visual in this view does not concern you: it stays in the view, unchanged.
visu.vue.masques_gardes.other: {n} visuals in this view do not concern you: they stay in the view, unchanged.

visu.vue.mode_annonce: Edit mode. “Discard changes” and “Save view” stay at the top of the page. Shortcut to save: {touches}.
visu.vue.nom_requis: The view has no name. Enter a name to find it again.
visu.vue.non_modifiable: Shared view: only an administrator can edit it.
visu.vue.quitter: Your changes to this view are not saved
visu.vue.tableaux_devenus_vues: Your dashboards are now views. They are shown as tabs.
visu.vue.trop_de_visuels: A view holds at most {max} visuals.
visu.vue.trop_de_visuels_ancienne: This view has {n} visuals, more than the {max} allowed. You can remove visuals, but you cannot add more.
visu.vue.trop_grande: The view definition is too large ({max} KB maximum).
visu.vue.vide_aide: Drag a KPI here, or click “Add to view”.
visu.vue.vide_aide_tel: This view is empty: tap “Add KPIs” to choose some.
visu.vue.annuler_confirmer: Discard your changes to this view? The visuals you added or changed are not saved.
